authors: P. Kuehler, D. Stoeckinger, M. Weisswange
title: The Standard Model with non-anticommuting gamma5 in the BMHV scheme
claim: Complete one-loop renormalization of the full SM in BMHV in general R_xi gauge, with all divergent and all finite symmetry-restoring counterterms; evanescent gauge interactions (4- vs D-dimensional photon and gluon currents) studied; QCD also contributes to the symmetry breaking, so the SM must be treated as a whole; purely 4-dimensional treatment of electroweak gauge interactions recommended.
cross_checks: S3.17_CFV2022 (earlier SM one-loop finite counterterm in BMHV via background field method)
